columns.text: [DRAFT] The coast that shaped the kitchen, the rhythm of the days and the roads onto the island. Bays, harbours and places you return to and stay.
[DRAFT] An island to be read in order: region by region, town by town, down to a single village. Stone, memory and history written into places.
[DRAFT] Bread, textile, ceramics, wine. Things born of need that stayed for life, and the people who still make them.
